datasets.label: Batters · season
datasets.source: Baseball Savant custom leaderboard (wOBA, xwOBA, BB%, K%)

datasets.label: Pitchers · season
datasets.source: Savant expected stats (xwOBA, ERA, xERA) + Savant statcast (barrel%, hard-hit%) + MLB (IP, GS)

datasets.label: 14-day hitters · Sep 14–Sep 27
datasets.source: MLB Stats API date range; wOBA built with the app's own linear weights

datasets.label: Splits · by player
datasets.source: MLB Stats API statSplits (vs LHP / vs RHP); wOBA built with the app's weights

datasets.label: Team · OAA / framing / xwOBA
datasets.source: Savant team OAA + team batting xwOBA + catcher framing summed by each catcher's CURRENT club (routed by player id)

notes: Every player is credited to his CURRENT club (MLB player id), the same rule the app's roster sync uses.
Framing is a season total, so a catcher traded mid-year is fully credited to his new club.
